comment: Params 20 and 21 (VOCT_1_DEPTH_PARAM, VOCT_2_DEPTH_PARAM) and each operator's misc menu button are declared with no widget. Each operator's wave bank knob sits at the same place as its multiplier knob, but the two are never visible together: DexterWidget::step hides the multiplier while the settings page is open and shows the bank knob only on the wave page, so a click reaches whichever one is on screen and both are tagged. The same holds for the three settings page buttons, which are shown only while the settings page is open, over the hidden wave, shape and level knobs. An operator's SYNC button has no effect until a cable is patched into one of that operator's four assignable modulation inputs, because DexterCore only processes sync while such a jack is connected.
